findings.summary: Spec §验收 requires 四命令全绿 (all four acceptance commands green). The committed .dd-evidence/acceptance.json records passed:false with 'npm test' exit_code=1 (1 failed | 876 passed, 877 total). The failing test is test/a10b-convergence.test.ts > B2 'real end-to-end harvest publishes evidence readable back from the channel', which timed out. npm test is not green, so the acceptance gate is not satisfied.

Acceptance evidence is inconsistent with the product tree at this commit: the committed 'npm test' failure reports 'Test timed out in 30000ms', but test/a10b-convergence.test.ts at this commit sets the B1/B2 timeout to 90000ms (the intended fix for the prior final-review blocker). This indicates the acceptance evidence was not regenerated against the current product tree, leaving the gate unverified.
